info.name: OmniVoid
info.description: Complete UI overhaul for DeepSeek. AMOLED true black (#000000) background, blood red accents (#8b0000), all blue elements replaced with purple (#9b30ff). Text: "DeepSeek" → "OmniVoid", "DeepThink" → "OmniThought". Icon: Whale → Bird silhouette. Red glow on input fields. 100% CSS, no JavaScript. Compatible with Stylus/Stylis
